dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: We'd better get this place tidied up before we can move the food in...

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, no need, haha! I'll do it myself, but thanks for the offer. I wouldn't want to trouble you with a trifle like this.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Me and Masa... Oh, I almost forgot, this Tatankasaurus here is Masa. We were supposed to deliver food, but a rampaging saurian careened into the warehouse, and, well...

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: What's done is done. It's no big deal, I'll have it tidied up in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Huh, me? No, I'm a farmer. If you have any questions about crop cycles, planting schedules, harvesting techniques, and the like, be sure to hit me up!

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Here at the Collective of Plenty, we don't really have an official granary manager. Or, to put it another way, everyone's a manager.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Whoever wants to take some food, well, they just need to have a word with Tonaca — she's in charge of planning and logistics.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If I may, your saurian companion seems a bit... lost.

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Hmm? Let me have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Xoctli
dialogues.text: Haha, it's nothing to worry about, the little blighter's just hungry. Once I've sorted out all this food, there'll be plenty of time for a hearty snack.
